title: Correct time calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must compute the time using the correct kinematic equation with the given acceleration and velocity change.

title: Correct distance calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must compute the distance using the correct kinematic equation with the given acceleration and velocity change.

title: Proper sign handling
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly account for the negative sign of acceleration in the kinematic equations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Important Criteria: The student must maintain consistent units throughout the calculation and present answers with correct units.

title: Decimal place precision
description: Optional Criteria: The student should round the final answers to one decimal place as specified in the problem.

title: Incorrect acceleration sign
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly uses positive acceleration in calculations, leading to negative time or distance.

title: Wrong kinematic equation
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student uses an inappropriate kinematic equation that doesn't apply to constant acceleration motion.
